about: SCION 22 takes: timed control tracks layered like Character Animator takes (later takes override earlier ones on the parameters they record). No camera, no webcam landmarks and no live performer exist here.

takes.name: Take 1 · capture (machine performance)
takes.source: paeleo/handmade/score/threshold-score.json frames[].dog (x, act.*): the PAELEO machine played as the performer
takes.honesty: no webcam, no microphone performer, no landmarks: this is the continuous response a live capture would give

takes.name: Take 2 · triggers
takes.note: each trigger is a gated, held beat; it fires a swap set or a pose and holds until the next trigger

events.what: crouch, ears flat, tail tucked, start backing
head leads away (head turner 0 -> 180 via the back of the head), body follows 3.50-4.02 through the Quarter and Back views
lies with its back to the door; gated until the turn has finished
chin on the paws, facing away
head comes round over the shoulder to the door while the body is still down
rises, head held on the door
body follows the head, 180 -> 0 through the Back view
walks; head carried below the back line for the whole approach
lies across the sill: front half in the doorway, tail outside
head turns into the lit room: back of the head to the viewer, muzzle past the jamb
chin back on the paws; stays

takes.name: Take 3 · head & body turner
takes.note: both body turns pass through the Back view (90): the dog shows its back to the camera while it turns; the head turns back through its Quarter-Front view (270), face toward the camera, so the face comes round first

takes.name: Take 5 · person
takes.source: score frames[].person (x, sit, reach, low); place mapped into my room (doorway -0.20 m, beside -0.80 m)
events: draws the hand back to her lap as she says come in: she asks and does not pull

editor_corrections: turn: the capture's turn track crosses zero only at 4.1 s and would show the back late; the Turn Away trigger leads with the head at 3.42 and has the back to the door by 3.9
lie: the capture starts lying at 4.3 while its turn track is still at -0.47 (lying down mid-turn reads as a collapse); gated until the body turner has finished (4.02)
look in: the capture's look track is a continuous ramp up and down; replaced by a held beat (26.80-28.02) on the Quarter-Back head view, so the look reads as a decision and a hold
head on the approach: capture head 0.45 kept, and the neck pivot is held below the back line for the whole walk (rig constraint, measured in trace)
gaze: the capture has no gaze; Take 4 adds snap gaze toward named targets with 2-frame saccades and holds
